P2 (user): channel columns spread to 21.8 mm pitch, top line regrouped (SEND A/B, gap, RTN A, RTN B, OUT/MAIN at 14 mm), J8 one pitch right, J6/J7 at Y58, J15/SW1/SW2 between IN3 and IN4. frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The carrier F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Right hole at the Doepfer position X7.5 + (20 - 3) x 5.08 = 93.86; left hole moved 1HP right (X12.58) as modules/4mix and modules/midi, so the pair is 16HP apart on the 2HP case grid.

main_pcb.note: 100.0 x 110.0 mm, 1.25 mm inside the rail gap at each end, 0.65 mm inside each panel side (modules/4mix + 10 mm). 4 layers; all SMD on B (single-sided assembly). R1 planes: In1 GND, In2 +3V3 with a +5VA island (codec, input drivers, finger to the regulator) and two +3V3_C islands. Held by the eleven jack nuts and three M3x10 standoffs.

columns_note: P2 (user: spread the channels into the side space): 21.8 mm pitch (4MIX 20.32), X17.9 / 39.7 / 61.5 / 83.3. Limits: J6/J7 box headers (B, courtyards 1.02 mm from the edge) must clear the SEND A pot lug pads (0.12 mm each side), which also gives equal 8.9 / 9.0 mm front margins outside the big-knob circles. Rows as modules/4mix P6: IN Y47, SEND A Y65.5, SEND B Y84, VOL Y106 (big VOL knobs).
jack_note: PJ301M-12 rot 0, placed by footprint origin (bushing axis): T pad above, TN/S below; courtyard X +/-4.79, Y -6.29..+7.84.

jacks.role: MIDI_IN (TS modular MIDI -> PA10 USART1_RX -> USB-MIDI)

pot_note: Bread Modular RV09 footprint, user-stock RV09 50k B, no bushing/nut. Rotation 0: pins 1-2-3 left to right 7.5 mm below the shaft. Courtyard about the shaft X -6.45..+6.46, Y -5.14..+8.70. DC dividers only (74HC4067 -> MCU ADC).

order: MCU board + USB-C (MS3 standoff above the USB-C)
top_line.note: User 2026-11-09: 20HP; the MCU board goes where modules/4mix had MAIN (RV1) and OUT (J5); OUT and MAIN one below the other. mcu_pcb.note: S3 (user 2026-11-10: single-sided MCU board, extended to the top of the main board with a cut-out for the screw, strips moved up): 29 mm wide (X70.6-99.6), Y10.25 (1.0 mm inside the carrier top edge) to Y45.7. Two 1x12 strips in the side columns, USB-C (Y21) over U101. 4 layers (In1 GND, In2 +3V3). All 25 SMD parts on F (facing the panel), nothing on B.

reserved_zones_mcu.what: U101 LQFP-64 as routed (S3): centre X86.0 Y32.2, below the USB-C; crystal Y101 left of it, U102 right of the USB-C

usb_slot.note: Obround NPTH slot for the receptacle shell (8.94 x 3.16 mm), as modules/usb-audio-max; the shell passes through and stands 1.3 mm proud.

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = carrier F.Cu, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.note: As modules/usb-audio-max: PJ301M-12 boss top = panel rear; the MCU board on 2.5 mm header plastic; HRO TYPE-C-31-D-15 1.3 mm proud of the 1.6 mm FR4 panel. The 10 mm standoffs fill carrier F to panel rear.

back_side_parts.band: Eurorack power, bottom-right side margin right of the CH4 VOL pot (P2: one pitch right of modules/4mix J8 + 5.08 so its pads and the IDC16 socket clear the RV401 lugs), pin 1 (-12 V) at the bottom row
CLK OUT, keyed 2x5 box header, left side margin (pads centre), pin 1 at the top; courtyard 1.02 mm from the edge and 0.12 mm left of the RV102 lug pad; J7 is 4.4 mm higher since S5

CLK IN, unshrouded 2x5 pin header (S5; was a keyed box header at Y58), right side margin (pads centre), pin 1 at the top right (X95.82 Y48.5); courtyard Y46.705..60.455, 0.20 mm below the R75 courtyard and 3.04 mm from the edge. No keying: red wire on pin 1 (silk marker); a turned plug is harmless (docs/research.md section 11)

SWD (WCH-LinkE) on B between the codec and J13 (S3, user: move the SWD pins): pin 1 +3V3 at Y22.54, then SWDIO Y20.0, SWCLK Y17.46, GND Y14.92 (pins run up); its solder tails come through on F under the MCU board (2.5 mm above the carrier): keep them under 2 mm
RESET, carrier top edge on B right of J12 (S3; NRST on J12.2)
BOOT, carrier top edge on B left of J12 (S3; BOOT0 on J12.1)

clock_link.note: J6 CLK OUT (keyed 2x5 box header, left edge, pads centre Y58) and J7 CLK IN (S5: unshrouded 2x5 pin header, right edge, pads centre Y53.58), both on B with pin 1 at the top: a slave sits LEFT of its master, so its J7 (right edge) is ~13 mm from the master's J6 (left edge, next module): a short 10-way ribbon, red wire on pin 1 at both ends. Silk 'CLK OUT / NOT POWER' at J6 and 'CLK IN - NOT POWER' beside J7. The pinout is power-cable safe either way round (docs/research.md D10 and section 11).

power_header.orientation: Vertical, pin 1 (-12 V) at the bottom row (as modules/4mix).

big_knob.note: As modules/4mix: keep-clear circle for a large knob (<= 18 mm) on each channel VOL.

mount_standoffs.hardware: per standoff: 1 x M3 F-F hex standoff 10 mm (user stock), 2 x M3x6 pan/button head (ISO 7380), as modules/4mix.
mount_standoffs.note: MS1/MS2 = modules/4mix D12, midway between the CH1/CH2 and CH3/CH4 VOL knobs (P2 columns). MS3 (P3, user: remove the two corner screws, one screw on top): centred above the USB-C (X84.1, in line with the plug force), as high as the 1 mm edge keep-out allows (B keep-out R3.5 1.0 mm from the edge); its hex is 0.65 mm above the MCU board, its panel bolt head 3.15 mm above the USB slot. Coaxial: carrier hole = panel hole.

parking.note: P1-P3 only (history): unplaced SMD parts were packed in columns right of the board. R1: nothing is parked.

usb_outs.note: P3 (user: two DAC outs from USB, assigned in the DAW, in the very corner; the IDC sockets are on the other side, so use that space): bottom-right side margin, X94.85 (courtyard 1.025 mm from the edge), 14.2 mm apart. Limits: J10 as low as the J8 power-header pads allow (S pad 1.24 mm above the J8 pin 9/10 pads; J8 and its IDC16 socket are on B), J9 above it; panel nuts 1.6 mm from the CH4 SEND B knob and 1.5 mm from the CH4 VOL big-knob circle; courtyards 0.34 mm right of the RV403/RV401 courtyards. J10's TN/S solder joints sit under the IDC16 socket envelope on B (socket bottom 2.5 mm above B): trim those leads to <= 1.5 mm.

midi_in.note: S5 (user: a TS MIDI input above the two USB outs, internal MIDI -> USB): J11 one 14.2 mm jack pitch above J9 in the right side margin, X94.85 Y67.9 (courtyard 1.025 mm from the edge, 0.10 mm above the J9 courtyard, panel nut ~1.7 mm from the CH4 SEND A knob as J9 is from SEND B). The J7 CLK IN header was in that spot on B and moved up (clock_link). R85 100k pull-up, R86 10k series and the D4 BAT54S clamp sit on B left of the jack (X88.4..91.6, Y69..76.5), >= 2.2 mm from the J11 and RV402 pads; MIDI_RX runs on B up the right edge (X97.9) to strip pin J13.11. Trim the J11 T lead to <= 2 mm: the J7 ribbon socket ends about 0.2-0.5 mm above it in plan (socket body 2.5 mm above B).
